summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a Rule 424(b)(5) takedown under its existing shelf registration, offering $6.75 billion aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes across three tranches: $2.5B 5.243% fixed/floating notes due 2032, $3.25B 5.729% fixed/floating notes due 2037, and $1.0B floating-rate notes due 2032 (SOFR-based). The notes carry make-whole and par redemption provisions and are issued under an existing base indenture supplemented by a fortieth supplemental indenture. This is an ordinary debt capital markets issuance, not a special situation; a pricing supplement will follow.
